_comments: NoOp is the only target the orders engine ships. It exercises the full provisioning
pipeline (status transitions, event log, reconcile sweep) without touching any outside
system — point a ProductEntitlement at it to test the plumbing, or leave
ProvisioningTargetID NULL for entitlements that need no downstream push at all.
Concrete targets (LXP enrollment, license servers) are seeded by the DEPLOYMENT that
ships their driver, alongside that driver's @RegisterClass — never here (plan §4.3).

fields.Name: No-Op (pipeline test)
fields.Description: Succeeds without doing anything. Exists so the provisioning pipeline can be exercised end to end before any real downstream target is configured.
